summary: TruBridge (TBRG) filed 8-K on April 23, 2026, announcing a definitive merger agreement with Inventurus Knowledge Solutions (Parent) and its wholly owned subsidiary Merger Sub. Under terms, each TruBridge share will be converted into $26.25 cash. The transaction is valued at approximately $26.25 per share. The board recommends the deal. A Voting and Support Agreement was signed with L6 Holdings, Pinetree Capital, and Ocho Investments, representing key stockholders. The merger is structured as a second-step merger with TruBridge surviving as a wholly owned subsidiary. Regulatory approvals and stockholder vote are required. Watch for timing, regulatory clearance, and any competing bids or appraisal demands.
